source.subject: English
source.extractionPreview:
Summer is hot.
To stay cool, 
everyone wants a 
dip in the pool.
Spring is a time,
when children play.
Flowers bloom,
every day.
Unit 4 
Seasons
Chapter 1
The Four Seasons
Let us sing
Reprint 2025-26

107
Mridang
Monsoon clouds
Are filled with rain,
Make you feel
Cool again.
1. (a) What do you wear in summer?
 
(b) What do you wear in winter?
 
(c) Which season do you like the most? Why?
Winter is cold.
On sunny days,
People enjoy the 
sun's rays.
Note to the teacher
• Help children answer in fu
